how: Starting is distributed between a general invitation and a member who begins placing while recruiting others.
Members recruit participants through invitations, instructions, immediate starts, and household help.
Assent remains conditional on enough people, with one participant estimating that ten or more users are needed.
A visitor's request receives a bare commitment without a demand for return help.
Members attempt and plan lettering beneath the shared logo.
Participants report starting and display progress while encouraging continued construction.
A shared sticky supplies the diagram and work location to prospective helpers.
Participants watch, repair, and defend completed work through repeated calls and individual commitments.
Individual reports of watching and defense do not determine whether scripts or spare accounts operated elsewhere.
Moderator guidance and external contact cannot establish decided internal order or test a claim about most rooms.
A participant attributes the attack to a named rival group without independently establishing every placer's identity.
Participants seek contact, propose spatial accommodation, and negotiate conditional noninterference.
Participants appeal for restraint, working around neighbours, and live-and-let-live conduct.
Help ranges from reciprocal defense to bare assistance, thanks, and identity-based refusal.
The smallest coalition form is a bilateral mutual-defense commitment without evidence of a larger council.
A member reports contacting another group's chat and offers to relay information without demonstrating delegated authority.
Contact and a request for blocks do not establish who ruled territory or possessed allocation authority.
Conditional noninterference and reciprocal commitments do not show a dispute over who can bind every placer.
Relocation is explicit, but the concepts do not establish the stipulated antecedent of erased or overrun work.
Resolving overlapping space includes relocating once and then accommodating another picture when invested work makes another move costly.

statement: Relocating through negotiated accommodation without a demonstrated loss
how: A negotiated move must remain explainable without requiring documented erasure or a manpower-caused defeat.
Football rivalry is carried through proposals to convert a rival's number and subsequent mockery of its failed mark.
Familiar joking language is carried into the design through LTD lettering and promises of the longest terms.
The rival's football sign is named in the same proposal that calls for covering or converting it.
An addition to the mark carries familiar wordplay as well as enlarging the design.
A member's overlapping fandom can limit cooperation proposed on a shared regional identity.
Participants perform and recognise a character joke alongside praise for the moderators' local change.
Local play includes proposing an affectionate summons, addressing a football figure's account, and inviting that figure into the subreddit.
A nested explanation following comparison with another subreddit cannot alone establish the host's exact styling change.
A proposed megathread is explicitly declined and withdrawn because placement has ended.
A participant questions the canvas's worth by interpreting its logos as unpaid branding and a possible hivemind experiment.
Positive evaluations of the finished canvas coexist with criticism without establishing a collective reversal.
Learning that placement ended removes the stated need for newly requested coordination infrastructure.
Participants celebrate completion, credit contributors, and describe enjoyment and teamwork.
Participants mark shutdown, regret the unfinished final pixel, and imagine additions that can no longer be placed.
A participant celebrates the shared logo's survival while mourning other personally valued drawings.
A late reader's question prompts an explanation of the completed undertaking rather than recruitment into its earlier build.
Claims of lasting visibility and counterfactual additions do not show successor organisation or reuse of the work.
Explaining survival and admiring the completed canvas do not establish disputes over corrected copies or historical versions.
Attack proposals include erasing, removing, converting, and offering a rival sign for another group's mark.
Retrospective victory is measured against the rival logo's failure and expressed through mockery and delight.
An invitation and a member's placing start supply occasions for recruitment, although starting and calling can occur in the same turn.
Calls are followed by reports of starting and progress, without identifying a separate cause for every participant's involvement.
A completion announcement receives an explicit call to maintain the finished work against adversaries.
Border accommodation can address prospective conflict and overlapping plans rather than follow demonstrated erosion of completed work.
Restraint may rest on avoiding vandalism and live-and-let-live norms without a documented settled border.
Defense under strain is visible, but the record does not show a resulting turn to machine placement.
Reports of progress are followed by completion claims and explicit praise for building together.
Recording fate and celebrating achievement can be combined in one post, leaving their proposed causal order unestablished.
Retrospective permanence and imagined additions do not establish a transition into a continuing undertaking.
An early need for numbers and a later move do not establish that manpower shortage caused relocation.
A documented diagram and later design addition do not show design argument being resolved by posting that diagram.
An own-room call may receive conditional assent about needed numbers rather than a bare join, while silent placing remains unknowable.
Help can arrive through incoming offers and requests without an observed shortage-driven appeal by the maintaining room.
Resolving overlap opens a channel for a neighbour's offer to help the relocated work.
The sequence from recruitment to attack talk does not by itself establish that recruitment caused a turn against rivals.
A proposal to remove a rival sign receives an explicit appeal to live and let live.
A restraint reply cannot establish compliance when a later participant still proposes converting the rival's sign.
Different branches show aggression and accommodation without establishing that a particular attack call caused the negotiation.
Rival-directed attack proposals precede retrospective mockery, but the speakers do not establish who actually erased the rival's pixels.
A bilateral commitment and incoming defense offer do not establish that the maintaining room chose coalition membership because it lacked hands.
Shared working instructions and a post-shutdown megathread withdrawal do not demonstrate that a flood of calls caused containment.
Border and defense commitments do not reveal a subsequent dispute over who may bind all members.
